title: Wireframes (section 7)
description: Text sketches of every screen and report the requirements put in front of a user. Illustrations, not designs: each one shows what a person sees and does, never how it is built.

id.description: Stable identifier; never reused or renumbered. The body holds a heading with this id and a wireframe fence under it.

title.description: What the person is looking at, in their words.

type.description: A screen the person works in, or a report the person reads.

journey_stage.description: The journey stage where they look at it.

illustrates.description: The requirements this sketch makes concrete.

shows.description: What each marked part of the sketch is for, in the order the marks appear.
